The test image shows a mango leaf with discrete dark brown/black oval spots scattered on the surface. No powdery coating, no sooty encrustation, no wilting.

This pattern matches Anthracnose (oval/irregular dark sunken spots on leaves). Let me confirm with one reference.

The reference shows a more advanced Anthracnose case (yellowed, heavily damaged leaf), but the symptom description clearly matches: "oval or irregular brown to deep brown sunken spots on leaves." The test image has exactly those discrete dark oval spots on an otherwise green leaf, consistent with early-stage Anthracnose.

- **Powdery_Mildew**: ruled out (no white powdery coating)
- **Sooty_Mould**: ruled out (no sooty black encrustation covering surface)
- **Die_Back**: ruled out (no wilting, curling, bark/stem symptoms)
- **Anthracnose**: matches — discrete irregular dark sunken spots on leaf
